department: Women, Child Development and Social Security
description: Financial assistance to girls from birth till the age of 18 to curb child marriage and promote education.
benefits: Total assistance of ₹40,000 in various stages from birth to 18 years.
application_process: Apply through Pragya Kendras or Child Development Project Office (CDPO).

description: Loan waiver scheme for small and marginal farmers of Jharkhand to provide relief from agricultural debts.
benefits: Loan waiver up to ₹50,000 for eligible farmers.
application_process: Register on the official portal or visit the nearest bank branch.

scheme_name: Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda Transnational Scholarship
department: Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority and Backward Class Welfare
description: Scholarship for higher education (Masters/M.Phil) in selected universities in the UK and Northern Ireland.
benefits: Full tuition fees, living expenses, and airfare covered.
application_process: Online application through the official scholarship portal.

description: Financial incentive for unemployed graduates and post-graduates to support them while seeking jobs.
benefits: ₹5,000 per annum for graduates, ₹7,000 for post-graduates (one-time or yearly as per policy).
application_process: Register on the Jharkhand Rojgar portal.

description: Promoting fruit-based horticulture for sustainable income in rural areas using MGNREGA funds.
benefits: Plants, fertilizers, and labor costs for 3-5 years; expected income of ₹50k-1 lakh per year.
application_process: Contact Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office.

scheme_name: PMAY-G (Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin) Jharkhand
description: Providing pucca houses with basic amenities to all houseless householders and those living in kutcha houses.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 lakh in plains and ₹1.30 lakh in hilly/difficult areas + MGNREGA labor.
application_process: Identification via SECC 2011 data and Gram Sabha verification.

description: World's largest health insurance scheme providing cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals.
benefits: Health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care.
application_process: Visit empanelled hospital or Common Service Centre (CSC) to get Ayushman Card.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Rajya Old Age Pension Scheme
department: Women, Child Development and Social Security
description: Monthly pension for elderly citizens who are not covered under national pension schemes.
benefits: ₹1,000 per month.
application_process: Apply at the Block Office or through the Sarvajan Pension Portal.

description: Skill development training for youth to enhance employability and encourage self-employment.
benefits: Free skill training, ₹1000/month transport allowance, and ₹1000-1500/month post-training allowance.
application_process: Apply at Block Level Skill Development Centers.

department: Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority and Backward Class Welfare
description: Post-matric scholarship for students belonging to SC, ST, and OBC categories studying in Jharkhand or outside.
benefits: Reimbursement of tuition fees and maintenance allowance.
application_process: Online application through E-Kalyan portal.

description: Rehabilitation of women involved in the sale of traditional liquor (Hadiya/Daru) by providing alternative livelihoods.
benefits: Interest-free loan of ₹10,000 for starting a small business or shop.
application_process: Identification by Sakhi Mandals (SHGs) and support from JSLPS.

description: Water conservation and groundwater recharge scheme focused on drought-prone areas of Jharkhand.
benefits: Creation of water harvesting structures; labor employment via MGNREGA.
application_process: Apply through Gram Sabha or Block Development Office.

description: Subsidized distribution of livestock (cows, goats, poultry, pigs) to increase farmers' income.
benefits: 50% to 90% subsidy on purchase of livestock.
application_process: Apply through the District Animal Husbandry Office.

department: Women, Child Development and Social Security
description: Financial assistance to adolescent girls for education and empowerment, replacing Sukanya Yojana with broader scope.
benefits: Financial aid at Class 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 and a lump sum at age 18-19 (Total ₹40,000).
application_process: Apply through School or Anganwadi Center.

description: Employment guarantee scheme for urban unskilled workers, similar to MGNREGA but for urban areas.
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of work in a financial year; unemployment allowance if work not provided within 15 days.
application_process: Register on the MSY portal or at the Urban Local Body (ULB) office.

description: Providing low-interest loans to students for pursuing higher education in professional courses.
benefits: Loan up to ₹15 lakh at 4% simple interest; no collateral required.
application_process: Apply through the dedicated Guru-Ji Student Credit Card portal.

description: Distribution of subsidized clothes to BPL families in Jharkhand.
benefits: One Dhoti/Lungi and one Saree at ₹10 each, twice a year.
application_process: Available at Public Distribution System (PDS) shops/Ration shops.

description: Providing subsidized transportation in rural areas while creating self-employment for youth.
benefits: Interest subvention on vehicle loans, exemption from road tax and permit fees for operators.
application_process: Apply through the District Transport Office (DTO).

description: Providing subsidized food grains to families not covered under the National Food Security Act (NFSA).
benefits: 5 kg of food grains per person per month at ₹1 per kg.
application_process: Apply for Green Ration Card through the Aahar portal.

description: Subsidy on petrol for two-wheeler owners who are ration card holders (CM-SUPPORTS).
benefits: ₹25 per liter subsidy for up to 10 liters per month (Total ₹250/month).
application_process: Apply through the CM-SUPPORTS App or Aahar portal.

description: Small and marginal farmers of Jharkhand
benefits: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year (₹2,000 per installment). Complementary to PM-KISAN scheme. Additional state support for agricultural inputs.
documents_required: Bank account details linked to Aadhaar
application_process: Register on Jharkhand Agriculture Portal or visit Block Agriculture Office. Submit land records and Aadhaar. Verification by Agriculture Officer. Amount transferred directly.

description: Senior citizens, widows, disabled persons from poor families
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 for senior citizens and widows. ₹1,000 per month for disabled persons. Direct bank transfer every month.
application_process: Apply at Block Development Office or online on Jharkhand e-District portal. Verification by BDO. Pension started within 30 days of approval.

description: SC/ST/OBC students preparing for competitive exams
benefits: Free coaching for JPSC, JSSC, Bank PO, SSC, UPSC exams. Stipend of ₹2,500 per month. Study material provided. Hostel facility for outstation students.
application_process: Apply online on JFCS portal. Entrance test conducted. Selection based on merit. Report to coaching centre after selection. Stipend credited monthly.

description: Homeless and kutcha house dwellers in Jharkhand
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹2 lakh for construction of pucca house. Additional ₹12,000 for toilet construction. Technical support from government engineers.
application_process: Register with Gram Panchayat. Survey by government official. SECC list verification. Money released in installments (40%-40%-20%) as construction progresses.

description: Meritorious students from poor families for higher education
benefits: Scholarship up to ₹15,000 per year for UG. Up to ₹25,000 per year for PG. Covers tuition fee, books, and living expenses.
application_process: Apply on National Scholarship Portal or Jharkhand e-scholarship portal. Institution verification. Amount transferred directly to student bank account.

description: Rural households seeking employment in Jharkhand
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of employment per year. Current wage rate ₹225 per day in Jharkhand. Payment directly to bank/post office account.
application_process: Register at Gram Panchayat office. Get Job Card issued. Apply for work 15 days in advance. Work provided within 15 days or unemployment allowance paid.

description: Unbanked households across India including Jharkhand
benefits: Zero balance bank account. RuPay debit card with ₹2 lakh accident insurance. Overdraft up to ₹10,000 after 6 months. Life insurance cover of ₹30,000.
documents_required: Aadhaar card or any valid ID proof
application_process: Visit nearest bank or business correspondent. Fill account opening form. Submit documents. Account opened same day. RuPay card issued within 10 days.

description: Educated unemployed youth registered with employment exchange
benefits: Monthly allowance of ₹5,000 for graduates. ₹3,500 for higher secondary. ₹2,000 for matriculates. Maximum for 2 years.
application_process: Register with District Employment Exchange. Apply for Berojgari Bhatta scheme. Documents verified by officer. Allowance credited monthly to bank account.

description: Senior citizens aged 60+ not covered under other pension schemes
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 deposited directly to bank account. Annual increase of ₹50 per year. Medical support at government hospitals.
application_process: Apply at Block Development Office. Panchayat secretary verifies. BDO approves. Pension starts next month after approval.

scheme_name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana in Jharkhand
description: Farmers with crop loans or voluntarily insured farmers
benefits: Crop insurance covering losses from natural calamities, pests, disease. Compensation up to sum insured. Premium subsidized by government (farmer pays only 2% for Kharif).
application_process: Apply through nearest bank, CSC, or Agriculture Department before sowing. Fill crop details. Premium deducted automatically for loanee farmers. Claim automatically processed after crop loss survey.

department: Agriculture Department in partnership with Banks
description: Farmers needing short-term agricultural credit
benefits: Credit up to ₹3 lakh at reduced interest rate of 4% per annum. Revolving credit for 5 years. Covers crop production, post-harvest, maintenance expenses.
application_process: Apply at nearest bank or Cooperative society. Fill KCC application. Land verification by bank official. KCC issued within 2 weeks of application.

description: Persons with physical, mental or other disabilities
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,000. Priority in government housing schemes. Priority in government job allocations. Free treatment at government hospitals.
documents_required: Disability certificate from CMO or government hospital
application_process: Apply at District Social Welfare Office. Disability certificate verified. Income verification done. Pension started within 45 days.

description: Unorganized sector workers and daily wage labourers
benefits: Employment guarantee during lean season. Skill training support. Accident insurance of ₹2 lakh. Health benefits under Ayushman Bharat.
documents_required: Unorganized Worker Registration Card (BOCW or e-Shram)
application_process: Register on e-Shram portal or BOCW Board. Get worker registration number. Apply for scheme benefits at Labour Department office or online.

description: ST students pursuing post-matriculation education
benefits: Maintenance allowance ₹550-₹1,200 per month. Tuition fee reimbursed. Study tour charges covered. Thesis research allowance for research scholars.
application_process: Apply on National Scholarship Portal (NSP). Institution verifies details. State Welfare Department approves. Amount credited to student's bank account.

scheme_name: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) in Jharkhand
description: Rural BPL households without pucca house
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1.30 lakh in plain areas. ₹1.50 lakh in hilly/difficult areas. Includes toilet under Swachh Bharat Mission. MGNREGS wages for labour.
application_process: Selection from SECC 2011 list by Gram Sabha. AwasApp registration. Geo-tagged photos at each construction stage. Money released in installments after verification.

description: Unorganized sector workers between 18-40 years
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after age 60. Pension for spouse after subscriber's death. Return of corpus to nominee.
application_process: Visit bank or open through banking app/CSC. Choose pension amount. Auto-debit set up from bank account. Government co-contributes for eligible subscribers.

department: Women, Child Development & Social Security Department
description: Adolescent girls aged 11-14 who dropped out of school
benefits: Non-formal education and skill training. Nutrition supplementation. Monthly nutrition package. Life skills and vocational training.
application_process: Register at nearest Aanganwadi centre. Aanganwadi worker conducts enrollment. Training sessions at Aanganwadi or SAKHI centre.

description: BPL women in rural areas without LPG connection
benefits: Free LPG connection. First gas cylinder free. Stove (chulha) provided free. EMI facility for refills. Reduces health hazards from wood/coal cooking.
documents_required: BPL ration card or SECC reference
Self-declaration about no existing LPG connection
application_process: Visit nearest LPG distributor. Fill PMUY application form. Submit documents. Verification done. Connection established within 7 days.

description: SC/ST entrepreneurs and youth wanting to start business
benefits: Seed funding up to ₹25 lakh. 40% subsidy on project cost. Mentorship support. Market linkage assistance. Tax benefits for 3 years.
application_process: Apply online on Jharkhand Startup Policy portal. Business plan reviewed by committee. Presentation to selection committee. Funds released in phases.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Nishakt Jan Vivah Sahayata Yojana
description: Persons with disability getting married
benefits: One-time marriage grant of ₹50,000 if both disabled, ₹25,000 if one is disabled. Additional ₹2,000 for marriage ceremony expenses.
documents_required: Bank account of bride and groom
application_process: Apply at District Social Welfare Office within 1 year of marriage. Documents verified. Approval by DSWO. Amount directly credited to couple's accounts.

department: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes Department
description: SC/ST students clearing UPSC/State PSC preliminary exams
benefits: One-time grant of ₹1 lakh for UPSC Main preparation. ₹50,000 for JPSC Main preparation. Coaching support at state government coaching centres.
application_process: Apply at SC/ST Department within 3 months of Prelim result. Documents verified. Amount credited to bank account within 30 days.

description: Youth aged 15-45 seeking skill development and employment
benefits: Free skill training in 200+ trades. Certification recognized nationally. Placement assistance. Monthly stipend during training. Post-placement tracking for 12 months.
application_process: Visit nearest PMKVY Training Centre or register on Skill India portal. Enroll in chosen trade. Complete training (3-6 months). Appear for assessment. Get certified.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - PM Jan Arogya Yojana (PMJAY)
description: Poor and vulnerable families (SECC 2011 listed)
benefits: Health coverage of ₹5 lakh per family per year. Free hospitalization at empaneled hospitals. Covers 1,500+ medical procedures. Pre and post hospitalization included.
application_process: Visit empaneled hospital or Ayushman Mitra desk. Get Ayushman card at nearest CSC. Show card at hospital for cashless treatment.

description: BPL families not covered under national health schemes
benefits: Health insurance of ₹2 lakh per family. Covers hospitalization for 700+ diseases. Includes pre-existing diseases from Day 1. Cashless treatment at government and empaneled hospitals.
application_process: Enroll at nearest CSC or Jan Seva Kendra. Smart health card issued. Use card at empaneled hospital. Cashless treatment up to coverage limit.

description: Construction workers registered with BOCW Board
benefits: Accident insurance of ₹2 lakh. Death benefit of ₹5 lakh. Education scholarship for children. Maternity benefit of ₹45,000. Housing loan subsidy.
application_process: Register with BOCW Board at District Labour Office. Pay ₹25 annual membership fee. Get registration card. Apply for specific benefits through BOCW portal or office.

scheme_name: NSP - OBC Scholarships for Jharkhand Students
description: OBC students from Class 1 to postgraduate level
benefits: Pre-matric scholarship ₹200-₹380 per month. Post-matric scholarship up to ₹1,200 per month. Tuition fee reimbursement. Book allowance.
application_process: Apply on National Scholarship Portal (NSP). Institution verifies. Ministry approves. Amount credited to bank account.

description: Traditional fishermen families of Jharkhand
benefits: Subsidy of 50% on boat and net purchase (max ₹50,000). Free fishing license. Accident insurance of ₹2 lakh. Kisan Credit Card at reduced interest.
application_process: Apply at District Fisheries Office. Documents verified. Selection committee reviews. Subsidy approved and credited. Insurance enrolled automatically.

description: Forest dwelling ST and OTF communities of Jharkhand
benefits: Right to cultivate forest land (up to 4 ha per family). Right to collect and sell minor forest produce. Rights over community forest resources. Support for cultivation.
application_process: File claim with Gram Sabha. FRC examines. SDLC/DLC approves. Forest land rights certificate issued. Revenue records updated.

description: Poor widows of Jharkhand
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,000. Priority in government housing scheme. Free treatment at district hospitals. Priority in food ration allocation.
application_process: Apply at Block Development Office. Panchayat verification. BDO approval. Pension starts within 30 days of approval.

department: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs / State Government
description: Street vendors in urban Jharkhand cities
benefits: Working capital loan of ₹10,000 (first time). ₹20,000 second loan. ₹50,000 third loan. No collateral required. 7% interest subsidy. Digital transaction incentive.
documents_required: Vending certificate or letter of recommendation from ULB
application_process: Apply through PM SVANidhi portal or MFI/bank. ULB verification of vendor status. Loan sanctioned within 30 days.

description: Farmers adopting modern agricultural techniques
benefits: 50% subsidy on improved seed purchase. Subsidy on micro-irrigation equipment. Free soil health card. Technical guidance from Agricultural Extension Officer.
application_process: Apply at Block Agriculture Office. Soil health card obtained. Demonstration plot established. Subsidized inputs provided directly. Technical training given.

description: BPL families that lost their primary bread earner
benefits: One-time lump sum benefit of ₹20,000. Amount deposited in family's bank account within 45 days of application.
application_process: Apply at Block Social Welfare Office within 1 year of death. Documents verified. DSW approves. Amount credited to bank account.

department: Rural Development & Jharkhand State Livelihood Mission
description: Women Self Help Groups in rural Jharkhand
benefits: Revolving fund of ₹15,000 per SHG. Bank loan linkage of ₹1-5 lakh at 4% interest. Capacity building training. Market linkage support.
application_process: Register SHG with block JSLPS coordinator. Minimum 6 months track record. Apply for bank linkage through JSLPS. Bank sanctions loan.

description: Small and marginal farmers with agricultural land
benefits: Annual input assistance of ₹5,000 per acre for land up to 5 acres. Maximum benefit ₹25,000 per year. Direct bank transfer before sowing season.
application_process: Auto-beneficiary identification from land records. Farmer notified via mobile. Verification at Panchayat level. Amount directly transferred to bank account.

description: Primitive Tribal Groups (PTGs) and particularly vulnerable tribal groups
benefits: Food security support. Housing assistance. Livelihood support. Healthcare access. Education support for children. Cultural preservation support.
application_process: Community outreach by Tribal Welfare officers. Gram Sabha identification. Block Tribal Welfare Officer enrolls. Benefits delivered at doorstep.

description: Children studying in government schools Class 1-8
benefits: Free nutritious mid-day meal every school day. Balanced diet as per nutritional norms. Cooking cost paid by government. Kitchen garden in schools.
application_process: Automatic enrollment upon school admission. Meal served every school day. Parents can verify on school notice board.

department: Women, Child Development & Social Security Department
description: Children 0-6 years, pregnant women, and lactating mothers
benefits: Supplementary nutrition from Aanganwadi. Immunization services. Health check-up. Referral services. Pre-school education for 3-6 year olds.
application_process: Register at nearest Aanganwadi Centre. Worker enrolls mother and child. Regular health check-ups at centre. Nutrition package collected monthly.

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
description: BPL widows aged 40-79 years
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹300 Central + ₹700 Jharkhand state top-up = ₹1,000 total per month.
application_process: Apply at Block Development Office. BPL verification. Panchayat recommendation. District Social Welfare Officer approval. Pension transferred monthly.

description: Members of unorganized occupational groups
benefits: Natural death benefit of ₹30,000. Accident death benefit of ₹75,000. Partial disability benefit of ₹37,500. Scholarship for children studying in Class 9-12.
application_process: Apply through respective occupational group organization. List sent to state government. Benefits paid at time of need.

description: Meritorious SC/ST students in Class 9-12
benefits: Monthly bursary of ₹900 for Class 9-10. ₹1,200 for Class 11-12. Paid for 10 months per year. Total ₹9,000 to ₹12,000 per year.
application_process: Apply at school or District SC/ST Welfare Office. School forwards application. District verification. Amount credited to student account quarterly.

description: Traditional artisans and craftspersons from 18 specific trades
benefits: Recognition as Vishwakarma with ID card. Skill training with ₹500/day stipend. Loan of ₹1 lakh (first phase) at 5% interest. Marketing support.
application_process: Apply on PM Vishwakarma portal or at CSC. Gram Sabha/ULB verification. PM Vishwakarma certificate issued. Training and loan accessed.

description: Urban poor, homeless, and migrant workers in Jharkhand cities
benefits: Skill training in market-demand trades. Job placement services. Temporary shelter support. Identity documents assistance. Linkage to government schemes.
application_process: Visit nearest Urban Livelihood Centre in Ranchi, Dhanbad, Jamshedpur, Bokaro. Register with livelihood counselor. Access skill training and job services.

description: Women entrepreneurs wanting to start or expand business
benefits: Interest-free loan up to ₹5 lakh for 3 years. 25% back-end subsidy on project cost. Marketing and design support. Capacity building training.
application_process: Apply at District Industries Centre. Business plan reviewed. Loan sanctioned through partner bank. Subsidy credited after project establishment.

description: Unskilled workers seeking certified skill training
benefits: Free skill training in ITI trades and NSQF courses. Daily allowance of ₹100 during training. Certification from NCVT/SSC. Placement support. Hostel during training.
application_process: Register on JEEVIKAAS portal or at nearest ITI/skill centre. Skill assessment done. Enroll in appropriate trade. Complete training. Assessment and certification.

description: Farmers interested in fruits, vegetables and spices cultivation
benefits: 75% subsidy on planting material. 50% subsidy on drip/sprinkler irrigation. Post-harvest infrastructure support. Cold storage subsidy. Market linkage.
application_process: Apply at District Horticulture Office. Land inspection by officer. Subsidy approved. Planting material provided at subsidized rate.

department: Health, Medical Education & Family Welfare Department
description: All Jharkhand families not covered under PMJAY
benefits: Health coverage of ₹5 lakh per family. Free treatment at government hospitals. Empaneled private hospitals for specialized care. Includes maternity benefits.
application_process: Register at CSC or health card camp. Smart health card issued. Show card at hospital. Cashless treatment up to ₹5 lakh coverage.

description: Small business owners, self-employed persons, micro enterprises
benefits: Collateral-free business loans: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishor (₹50,001 to ₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh). No processing fee. Flexible repayment.
application_process: Apply at any bank, MFI, or NBFC. Fill Mudra loan application. Submit business plan. Bank verifies and sanctions within 7-10 working days.

description: Rural poor families for sustainable livelihood improvement
benefits: Livelihood activity support up to ₹1.5 lakh. Convergence with MGNREGS, PMAY, and other schemes. Skill training. Market linkage. Community investment fund.
application_process: Contact village-level community resource person (CRP) or JSLPS block coordinator. Participatory Rural Appraisal done. Livelihood plan prepared. Fund released.

description: All small and marginal farmers across India including Jharkhand
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three installments of ₹2,000 each. Directly transferred to farmer's bank account. No application fee.
application_process: Register on PM-KISAN portal or at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). Aadhaar-based verification. Amount auto-credited every 4 months.

department: Food, Public Distribution & Consumer Affairs Department
description: Paddy farmers wanting to sell at Minimum Support Price
benefits: Guaranteed purchase of paddy at MSP (currently ₹2,183 per quintal). No middleman. Direct payment within 48 hours. Saves farmers from distress selling.
application_process: Register at nearest procurement centre. Bring paddy to designated mandi. Paddy weighed and checked. MSP amount transferred to bank account within 48 hours.

department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
description: SC/ST borrowers and women entrepreneurs for greenfield enterprises
benefits: Bank loan between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for manufacturing, service, or trading sectors. Composite loan (term + working capital). 7-year repayment. 18-month moratorium.
application_process: Apply at scheduled commercial bank or through Stand-Up India portal (standupmitra.in). Bank evaluates business plan. Loan sanctioned with government guarantee.

description: Farmers and rural households engaged in animal husbandry
benefits: Subsidy on purchase of cows/buffaloes (50% up to ₹40,000). Goat rearing support (75% subsidy for BPL). Free vaccination for animals. Technical training.
application_process: Apply at Block Animal Husbandry Office. Inspection by veterinary officer. Subsidy approved. Animal purchased through empaneled vendor. Training provided.

department: Ministry of Rural Development / Social Welfare Department
description: Poor elderly, widows, disabled persons below poverty line
benefits: Old Age Pension ₹200-₹500/month (Central) + state top-up making it ₹1,000/month. Widow pension ₹300/month + state top-up. Disability pension ₹300/month + top-up.
application_process: Apply at Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office. BDO verifies. District Social Welfare Officer sanctions. Pension transferred monthly to bank account.

description: Farmers suffering crop loss due to natural calamities
benefits: Compensation of ₹3,500 per acre for 30-50% crop loss. ₹4,000 per acre for more than 50% crop loss. Maximum 5 acres covered. Paid directly to bank account.
application_process: Register on Jharkhand Fasal Rahat portal before or during sowing season. Calamity declared by government. Survey conducted. Compensation auto-credited.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces
department: Ministry of Home Affairs / Kendriya Sainik Board
description: Children/widows of CAPF and assam rifles personnel
benefits: Scholarship of ₹3,000/month for boys and ₹3,600/month for girls. Duration equals course duration. For professional courses only.
application_process: Apply on National Scholarship Portal (NSP). Documents uploaded online. Verification by Kendriya Sainik Board. Scholarship credited to student account.

description: All citizens of Jharkhand needing government certificates
benefits: Online issuance of income certificate, caste certificate, domicile/residence certificate, birth/death certificate, land records etc. Delivery within 7 working days. Nominal fee.
application_process: Visit jharkhand.gov.in/eDistrict or nearest Jan Seva Kendra. Select service. Fill online form. Pay fee. Track status. Certificate delivered digitally or collected.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Bank account holders aged 18-50 years
benefits: Life insurance coverage of ₹2 lakh on death from any cause. Annual premium only ₹436 auto-debited from bank account. Simple claim process.
application_process: Contact bank or enroll through banking app/Jandhan portal. Sign consent form. ₹436 auto-deducted annually. Nominee claims ₹2 lakh on death.

description: Bank account holders aged 18-70 for accident insurance
benefits: ₹2 lakh for accidental death or permanent total disability. ₹1 lakh for permanent partial disability. Auto-renewal. Only ₹20/year premium.
application_process: Enroll at bank or banking app. Sign consent. ₹20 auto-deducted annually from bank account. Nominee claims on accidental death/disability.

department: Women, Child Development & Social Security Department
description: Girl children from all families in Jharkhand
benefits: Fixed deposit of ₹6,000 in child's name. Additional benefits at key milestones: school enrollment, Class 6, Class 9, Class 12. Total benefit up to ₹1.18 lakh.
application_process: Register at nearest Aanganwadi centre within 1 year of birth. Aanganwadi worker fills form. Block office processes. Fixed deposit created in girl's name.

description: Farmers in drought-prone areas of Jharkhand
benefits: Construction of check dams, ponds, well recharging. Irrigation structures for small farmers. Water conservation structures up to ₹2 lakh per unit. Improved crop yields.
application_process: Apply through Gram Panchayat. Village water conservation plan prepared. Approved structures built through MGNREGS convergence. Farmer benefits from irrigation.

description: Students from economically weaker sections in higher education
benefits: Full tuition fee waiver at government colleges. Maintenance allowance ₹1,000-₹1,500/month. Book grant ₹3,000 per year. Hostel fee assistance.
application_process: Apply at college or on state scholarship portal. Income verification by Circle Officer. College verifies admission. Scholarship credited to student account.

scheme_name: PMEGP - Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
department: Ministry of MSME / KVIC / State Government
description: Unemployed youth and self-help groups for new enterprise setup
benefits: Subsidy on project cost: 15-25% for urban (25-35% for special categories). 25-35% for rural (35-45% for special categories). Bank loan for rest. For projects ₹25 lakh (manufacturing) and ₹10 lakh (services).
application_process: Apply on PMEGP portal. Shortlisted candidates attend EDP training. Bank sanctions loan. Subsidy released after successful implementation. Repay bank loan.

description: Migrant workers returning to Jharkhand from other states
benefits: Skill assessment and reskilling support. Seed money for self-employment (up to ₹50,000). Linkage with PMEGP, MUDRA, and state schemes. Priority in MNREGA employment.
application_process: Register at Block Labour Office on return. Skill assessment conducted. Counseling session. Connected to nearest skill training centre or given self-employment support.

department: Women, Child Development & Social Security Department
description: Adolescent girls aged 11-18 in rural and urban areas
benefits: Monthly nutrition supplementation. Iron and folic acid tablets. Menstrual hygiene management support. Life skills education. Vocational training for girls 16-18. Health check-up.
application_process: Automatic enrollment through Aanganwadi centre. Register with Aanganwadi worker. Monthly sessions at Aanganwadi or SAKHI centre. Monthly package collected.

scheme_name: Jharkhand One District One Product (ODOP) Scheme
description: Artisans, craftspersons and micro entrepreneurs for local products
benefits: Branding and packaging support. E-commerce platform listing (GeM, Amazon Saheli etc.). Bank loan at subsidized interest. Marketing events participation. Training in product quality improvement.
application_process: Apply at District Industries Centre. Products evaluated by committee. Artisan registered under ODOP. Training arranged. Products listed on e-commerce platforms.

description: All families in Jharkhand for secondary and tertiary health care
benefits: Health coverage of ₹5 lakh per family per year. Covers 1,700+ treatment packages. Free surgery, dialysis, cancer treatment, and other specialized procedures at empaneled hospitals.
application_process: Visit CSC or Jan Seva Kendra for Ayushman card. Card generated free of cost. Show card at empaneled hospital. Cashless treatment begins immediately.

description: Rural villages without proper connectivity bridges
benefits: Construction of small bridges (culverts, RCC bridges) connecting villages to main roads. Improves access to markets, schools, hospitals. Employment during construction under MGNREGS.
application_process: Gram Sabha passes resolution for bridge. Application submitted to Block office. Survey by Rural Works Department. Construction approved and carried out.

description: Farmers for agricultural mechanization and modern equipment
benefits: 50% subsidy on purchase of tractors, power tillers, threshers, seed drills. Maximum subsidy ₹1 lakh per machinery. One machinery per farmer per year. Reduces manual labour cost.
application_process: Apply at Block Agriculture Office. Inspection of land holdings. Subsidy sanctioned. Purchase from empaneled dealer. Subsidy credited to bank account.

scheme_name: PM Awas Yojana Urban (PMAY-U) in Jharkhand
description: Urban EWS/LIG/MIG families without pucca house in cities
benefits: Interest subsidy of 3-6.5% on home loans (Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme). Direct subsidy on construction cost up to ₹1.5 lakh for EWS. Priority for SC/ST, minorities, disabled, single women.
application_process: Apply through Urban Local Body (Nagar Panchayat/Nagar Parishad) or online on PMAY portal. Verification by ULB. Subsidy released in installments.

description: Rural households and farmers for solar energy access
benefits: Subsidized solar home lighting systems. Solar irrigation pumps (2-7.5 HP) for farmers at 30-90% subsidy. Free solar lamps for BPL households. Reduces electricity bills.
application_process: Apply at Block or JREDA district office. Site inspection. Subsidy approved. System installed by empaneled vendor. Farmer pays only subsidy balance amount.

department: Ministry of Education / Department of School Education
description: Meritorious students from economically weaker sections studying in Class 9-12
benefits: ₹12,000 per year (₹1,000 per month) for students from Class 9 to Class 12. Renewed annually on passing each class. Directly transferred to student account.
application_process: School nominates eligible students. State-level NMMS examination held in November. Qualified students get scholarship automatically. Renewed each year.

description: Micro and small enterprise owners wanting to expand
benefits: 50% subsidy on technology upgradation (max ₹5 lakh). Interest subvention of 5% on working capital loans. Market development assistance. ISO certification support.
application_process: Apply at District Industries Centre (DIC). Application verified. Inspection of enterprise. Subsidy sanctioned by DIC. Amount credited after purchase of machinery/equipment.

department: Women, Child Development and Social Security
description: Enhanced financial assistance for women, especially those linked with Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
benefits: Stronger financial support for SHG-linked women. Part of the 25th Foundation Day initiatives.
application_process: Apply through local SHG or Aanganwadi centers.

description: Crop insurance scheme to protect farmers against financial loss due to natural calamities.
benefits: Financial compensation for crop failure due to drought, floods, etc.
application_process: Register on the dedicated portal or visit CSC/Bank.
